from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

source = Path("./uploads/Meeting_Notes_2024_06.docx")
destination = Path("./Meeting_Notes_2024_06_paragraphs.txt")

word_namespace = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
paragraph_tag = f"{{{word_namespace}}}p"
text_tag = f"{{{word_namespace}}}t"
tab_tag = f"{{{word_namespace}}}tab"
break_tags = {
    f"{{{word_namespace}}}br",
    f"{{{word_namespace}}}cr",
}

with ZipFile(source) as archive:
    document_xml = archive.read("word/document.xml")

root = ET.fromstring(document_xml)
paragraphs = []

for paragraph in root.iter(paragraph_tag):
    parts = []
    for element in paragraph.iter():
        if element.tag == text_tag:
            parts.append(element.text or "")
        elif element.tag == tab_tag:
            parts.append("\t")
        elif element.tag in break_tags:
            parts.append("\n")
    paragraphs.append("".join(parts))

destination.write_text("\n".join(paragraphs), encoding="utf-8")

print(
    f"Saved {len(paragraphs)} paragraphs to "
    f"{destination.resolve()} ({destination.stat().st_size} bytes)"
)
